en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, form Ibn Mahboub, from one of his companions, 
Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> has said:
‘The slanderer of the bastard would be penalised (by the Penalty (Hadd)), and the slanderer of the son of a woman cursed by her husband would be penalised (by the Penalty (Hadd))’.
